controls.title: Protected API rejects anonymous requests
controls.remediation: Require a server-validated session before protected route logic runs.

controls.title: Customer cannot invoke bank-administrator functions
controls.remediation: Enforce role authorization at the API service layer on every administrator route.

controls.title: Customer cannot read another customer's account history
controls.remediation: Bind account reads to the authenticated customer in the database query.

controls.title: Customer cannot transfer from an unowned account
controls.remediation: Check source-account ownership in the trusted transfer service before posting ledger entries.

controls.title: Logout prevents replay of the terminated session
controls.remediation: Revoke the session token identifier on logout and enforce the revocation list on later requests.
